report.headline: Firmware migration to ML-DSA-87 is INCOMPATIBLE due to unsupported bootloader self-update

main_causes.text: The transition is INCOMPATIBLE because the required bootloader self-update is unsupported on this board.
Critical invariants regarding the transition step and dual-policy plans remain UNKNOWN.

verified.text: The signed factory image fits within the boot partition.
The transitional verifier correctly rejects factory images signed with the wrong key.
Initial boot sequences were successful in emulated environments.

unknowns.text: RAM and stack usage are UNKNOWN as stack painting was not performed.
Dual signature policy behavior is UNKNOWN due to a failed dual signature build.
The non-atomic update window and interrupt recovery are UNKNOWN.

report.executive_summary: The assessment concludes that the migration is INCOMPATIBLE and the transition is INCOMPATIBLE. The primary blocker is that the bootloader self-update required for the transition is unsupported on the target hardware. Additionally, the candidate verdict is INDETERMINATE because several critical invariants (INV-I2, INV-I3, INV-I4) remain UNKNOWN due to missing evidence regarding dual-signature policies and update atomicity. While basic layout requirements and negative authentication tests were satisfied, the lack of support for the self-update mechanism prevents a successful migration path.

proposals.title: Field Service Bootloader Reflash
proposals.rationale: The current blocker REQ-BOOT-S0S1 is caused by the bootloader self-update being unsupported on this board. By using a technician to re-flash the bootloader via the debug port, the need for a self-update transition is bypassed.
preconditions: Physical access to the device debug port
tradeoffs: Requires manual intervention by a technician
Cannot be performed as a remote over-the-air update

proposals.title: Staged Hybrid Dual Signature Transition
proposals.rationale: This plan proposes an intermediate bootloader that accepts both signature schemes. This may address INV-I3, which is currently UNKNOWN due to a gap (GAP-O05-DUAL-POLICY) regarding the dual signature build and behavioral matrix.
preconditions: Successful creation of a dual-signature build on the pinned commit
tradeoffs: Increased bootloader complexity to support two verification schemes

tradeoffs: Temporary increase in boot time due to dual verification

calls.message:
The migration phase verdict is "INCOMPATIBLE". This is driven by the following blocking IDs:

*   [REQ-BOOT-S0S1]: This critical requirement is "VIOLATED" because the declared transition requires a bootloader self-update, which is "UNSUPPORTED" on this board [EV-E11-SELF-UPDATE].
*   [INV-I2], [INV-I3], and [INV-I4]: These critical invariants are "UNKNOWN", with [INV-I3] and [INV-I4] linked to gaps [GAP-O05-DUAL-POLICY], [GAP-E10-INTERRUPT], and [GAP-E12-NON-ATOMIC].
